mechanism: Armodafinil may antagonize the antipsychotic efficacy of perphenazine through dopaminergic and noradrenergic stimulation, while perphenazine may reduce armodafinil's wakefulness-promoting effects via dopamine receptor antagonism.
action: Monitor for reduced efficacy of either drug; consider alternative stimulant or antipsychotic if therapeutic goals are not met, and ensure close clinical oversight for mood and psychotic symptom changes.
